The `will_not_bid` status is the same as `invitation_last_sent_at` not being null, `is_bidder_committed` being false, `submitted` being false, & `awarded` not being true.
The `will_bid`     status is the same as `invitation_last_sent_at` not being null, `is_bidder_committed` being true,  `submitted` being false, & `awarded` not being true.
The `submitted`    status is the same as `invitation_last_sent_at` not being null, `is_bidder_committed` being true,  `submitted` being true,  & `awarded` not being true.
The `awarded`      status is the same as `invitation_last_sent_at` not being null, `is_bidder_committed` being true,  `submitted` being true,  & `awarded` being true.
